title: 第1737章 轮回殿主的真正目的第1736章 目标复苏的军团
content_zh:
四旺将手里的铁蜡木茶杯放在桌上。
“混沌笼炉全功率运转，轮回时序光纹已正式启用，六品法则丹完美品质占比稳定在八成以上。
只要五品和六品神药供应跟得上，丹药不会拖后腿。
我唯一担心的是六品神药的库存，失落之域带出来的那批七品以上神药暂时不能动，五品和六品的库存在最近几轮大批量炼制后已消耗了近半。
水界珠百倍加速虽然快，但神药生长周期最短也要外界几十天，赶不上下一次大战的话，库存会见底。”
“神药库存的事我来解决。
水界珠源脉品阶已接近七品门槛，等我修为再进一步，可以尝试将源脉品阶推到真正的七品。
到那时七品神药也能在百倍加速下正常生长，六品神药的产量也会翻倍。”
李衍道说完，转向柳三，“丹塔那边的二品到四品丹药产量继续保持。
仙界来的族人还在源源不断地突破源王，低阶丹药需求量短期内不会下降。
你辛苦些，七十二座丹塔全部开满。”
柳三应了一声，又补了一句：“最近一批从百战域运来的三品火纹草品相极好，火系法则丹的良品率比上月提升了两成。
如果百战域的补给线能保持畅通，三品和四品丹药的产量还能再提。”
阎在旁边低声说了一句：“补给线的安全我让影刺再多加两组暗哨，不会再出现被炸毁四根阵柱的事。”
李衍道将沙盘上的布置逐条确认完毕后直起身，目光从议事殿中每个人的脸上扫过。
小七的涅盘火种虽只恢复了三成，但涅盘之火对邪神残部的克制效果，不会因为火种能量不足而打折扣。
烧血祭军团残部，三成能量的涅盘之火绰绰有余。
李法瞳的时空日晷神国，在操控护域大阵和情报网络时比任何阵盘都精准，时空双血脉的法则感知力，能在第一时间，发现潜入药王域外围的任何异常法则波动。
四旺蹲在混沌笼炉旁可以连续炼制数月不停歇，六品法则丹的库存堆到历史最高不是空话。
阎的影刺暗哨遍布三十六域和神族地域边界，任何风吹草动都逃不过他的感应阵盘。

金二牙和金三牙守在演武场，新一批源王巅峰的突破训练已排好日程。
“各自准备。轮回殿主在暗处等我们露出破绽，邪神残部从四面八方朝极北冰原汇聚。
我们不露破绽，他们就得强行出手。
强行出手就会犯错，犯错就会死。”
李衍道从沙盘前走开，回到自己在议事殿中的位置，“接下来这段时间，把所有力量都投入到战备中。
等防线布好，等丹药堆满，等失落之域出口随时可以打开的讯号亮起，就是我们主动出击的时候。”
神族地域深处，远古战场废墟。
血翼神族废弃祖地外围数千里，一座被风沙掩埋了大半的远古战场废墟最深处，血祭军团的残部正在加速复苏。
复苏的迹象，最初只是废墟表层岩板上，偶尔闪过的微弱暗红荧光，荧光闪烁的频率极低。
但随着时间推移，闪烁频率越来越快，荧光亮度越来越强，废墟深处传来的法则波动，也从若有若无的低频震荡，变成了有规律的高频脉冲。
废墟中央一座半塌的远古祭坛正下方，封存了上千万年的血祭军团休眠舱正在逐一开启。
休眠舱的外壳由血祭法则凝聚而成，呈暗红色的半透明晶体状，每一具休眠舱中，都封存着一名血祭军团的战士。
这些战士的容貌，保持在远古大战时期被封印时的状态，皮肤呈不自然的灰白色，眼眶深陷，嘴唇干裂，身上的战甲已朽得不成样子，但体内的血祭法则还在缓慢运转。
上千万年的休眠没有杀死他们，只是将他们的生命体征压到了最低。
第一具休眠舱在血祭法则震荡达到临界点时炸开，舱内的血祭战士睁开眼，眼眶中没有眼球，只有两点暗红的光。
他从碎裂的舱体中坐起来，干涸了上千万年的喉咙里，发出一声嘶哑呼吸声，然后从休眠舱中爬出来，单膝跪在祭坛前。
祭坛上刻着的血祭法则纹路，在他跪下的瞬间亮起，一道血色光柱从祭坛中央射出，穿透废墟上方的岩层，直冲云霄。
血色光柱在云层中炸开，化作一圈扩散的血色光环，光环绕过小半个神族地域。
光环扩散的同时，废墟更深处成百上千具休眠舱同时炸裂，血祭军团的战士们从舱中爬出来，齐刷刷跪在祭坛前。
content_en:
Siwang placed the iron wax wood tea cup in his hand on the table.
"The Chaos Cage Furnace is operating at full power, the reincarnation timing light pattern has been officially activated, and the proportion of perfect quality sixth-grade law pills has stabilized at more than 80%.
As long as the supply of fifth-grade and sixth-grade magical medicines can keep up, the elixirs will not be held back.
The only thing I'm worried about is the inventory of sixth-grade magic medicine. The batch of seventh-grade and above magical medicines brought out by the Lost Realm cannot be moved for the time being. The inventory of fifth-grade and sixth-grade magic medicine has been consumed by nearly half after the recent rounds of large-scale refining.
Although the hundred-fold acceleration of the Water Boundary Pearl is fast, the shortest growth cycle of the magic medicine takes dozens of days. If it cannot catch up with the next war, the inventory will bottom out. "
“I will take care of the inventory of the magic medicine.
The level of the Water Realm Pearl Source Vein is close to the threshold of the seventh level. When I advance further in my cultivation, I can try to push the level of the Source Vein to the real seventh level.
By then, the seventh-grade magical medicine will be able to grow normally at a hundred-fold acceleration, and the output of the sixth-grade magical medicine will also double. "
After Li Yandao finished speaking, he turned to Liu San, "The output of second- to fourth-grade elixirs at the Danta Tower continues to be maintained.
The tribesmen from the Immortal Realm are still continuously breaking through the Source King, and the demand for low-level elixirs will not decrease in the short term.
You work harder, all seventy-two alchemy towers are fully activated. "
Liu San responded and then added: "The latest batch of third-grade fire pattern grass shipped from Baizhan Domain is in excellent condition, and the yield rate of fire law pills has increased by 20% compared to last month.
If the supply lines in Baizhan Domain can remain open, the production of third- and fourth-grade elixirs can be increased again. "
Yan whispered from the side: "To ensure the safety of the supply line, I will ask Shadow Thorn to add two more hidden sentries. This will prevent four formation pillars from being blown up again."
After confirming the arrangements on the sand table one by one, Li Yandao straightened up and glanced at the faces of everyone in the meeting hall.
Although Xiao Qi's Nirvana Fire has only recovered 30%, the restraining effect of Nirvana Fire on the remnants of the evil god will not be compromised due to insufficient fire energy.
Burning blood to sacrifice the remnants of the legion, 30% of the energy of the Nirvana Fire is more than enough.
Li Fatong's Space-Time Sundial Divine Kingdom is more accurate than any formation disk in controlling the domain protection formation and intelligence network. The law perception of the dual bloodlines of time and space can detect any abnormal law fluctuations sneaking into the periphery of the Medicine King's territory at the first time.
Siwang squatted beside the Chaos Cage Furnace and could refine it for several months without stopping. It was not empty talk that the inventory of sixth-grade Law Pills had reached the highest level in history.
Yan's Shadow Thorns are all over the borders of the Thirty-six Domains and the Divine Clan, and no disturbance can escape his induction array.
Jin Erya and Jin Sanya were guarding the martial arts field, and the breakthrough training for the new batch of Origin Kings was scheduled.
"Prepare each other. The Master of Samsara Palace is waiting in the dark for us to reveal our flaws, and the remnants of the Evil God are gathering from all directions toward the far north ice field.
If we don't reveal our flaws, they will have to take action forcefully.
If you force it, you will make a mistake, and if you make a mistake, you will die. "
Li Yandao walked away from the sand table and returned to his position in the meeting hall, "In the next period of time, put all your strength into combat preparations.
When the defense line is set up, when the elixirs are piled up, when the signal that the exit of the Lost Realm can be opened at any time comes on, it is time for us to take the initiative. "
Deep in the Protoss region, there are ruins of ancient battlefields.
Thousands of miles outside the abandoned ancestral land of the Bloodwing Gods, deep in the ruins of an ancient battlefield that was mostly buried by wind and sand, the remnants of the Blood Sacrifice Legion are accelerating their recovery.
The signs of recovery were initially just faint dark red fluorescence that occasionally flashed on the surface rock of the ruins. The frequency of fluorescent flashes was extremely low.
But as time went by, the flickering frequency became faster and faster, the fluorescence brightness became stronger and stronger, and the regular fluctuations coming from the depths of the ruins also changed from vague low-frequency oscillations to regular high-frequency pulses.
Directly under a half-collapsed ancient altar in the center of the ruins, the dormant capsules of the Blood Sacrifice Legion that had been sealed for tens of millions of years were being opened one by one.
The shell of the dormant cabin is condensed by the law of blood sacrifice. It is in the shape of a dark red translucent crystal. Each dormant cabin has, all contain a soldier from the Blood Sacrifice Legion.
The appearance of these warriors remained in the same state as when they were sealed during the ancient war. Their skin was an unnatural gray-white color, their eye sockets were sunken, their lips were chapped, and their armors were rotten to the point of decay, but the laws of blood sacrifice in their bodies were still running slowly.
Tens of millions of years of dormancy did not kill them, but only reduced their vital signs to the lowest level.
The first dormant cabin exploded when the vibration of the Blood Sacrifice Law reached the critical point. The Blood Sacrifice warrior in the cabin opened his eyes. There were no eyeballs in the eye sockets, only two dark red lights.
He sat up from the broken cabin, let out a hoarse breath from his throat that had been dry for tens of millions of years, then crawled out of the dormant cabin and knelt on one knee in front of the altar.
The pattern of the Blood Sacrifice Law engraved on the altar lit up the moment he knelt down. A bloody beam of light shot out from the center of the altar, penetrated the rock formations above the ruins, and shot straight into the sky.
The blood-colored light pillar exploded in the clouds, turning into a spreading blood-colored halo, and the light surrounded half of the God Clan's territory.
At the same time as the halo spread, hundreds of sleeping cabins deeper in the ruins exploded at the same time. The soldiers of the Blood Sacrifice Legion crawled out of the cabins and knelt in front of the altar.
